name: Skelo's Horrific Madness
summary:
This is Skelo's Horrific Madness..

Run around the maps with your friends, or go out alone. In this medieval themed horror game, run from monsters, check out what the shopkeepers have to sell, and explore the infinite wonders!

This game is in early access, so right now there is lots more expected in the near upcoming future, so we hope you enjoy what we have, and also what there is to come soon!

Thank you for playing Skelo's Horrific Madness.
